en.title: Minimum Initial Health to Stay Positive with One Armor Use
en.description:
Pass the levels in order; level i deducts power[i] health, and health must stay strictly greater than 0 at all times. Armor may be used on at most one level to cancel min(armor,power[i]) damage. Find the minimum initial health.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n armor; the second line contains the damage values. The main source gave no numeric bounds; they are filled in from amazon-minimum-starting-health-to-win-the-game.md, the same problem in the same snapshot: 1≤n≤100000, 1≤damage,armor≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 12, 6 and 1. Even if all damage is blocked, at least 1 health is still required.
hints: Use the armor on the level with the largest damage; the answer is total damage−min(armor,largest damage)+1.
